digest.component_or_area: rebar link command and caused_by relation validation
propositions: caused_by links currently accept any target without validating that the target has a referencing commit in the code repository, leading to misattributions
the caused_by validation logic exists only in close_precheck._referencing_commits (private) and needs to be hoisted into shared commit_impact.py as a single implementation
caused_by links must be refused if the target has zero referencing commits, unless bypassed by --force flag on CLI/library/MCP
the refusal predicate caused_by_refusal must be called by both link_core (write) and _link_dry_run (preview) to keep them synchronized
a commit-less code repository or unreadable git history should allow the link (unverifiable is not invalid), while a verified commit-less target should block it
the --force escape hatch must be available on rebar link, rebar claim, and MCP operations with unified spelling and parsing in extract_force
